decisions.decision: pi deliberately sends its own 'pi (<os> <release>; <arch>)' User-Agent; barness sends the openai-go default. Undecided whether barness adopts its own User-Agent, and whether exposing host OS release is acceptable in multi-tenant cloud use.
pi stamps every assistant message with creation time (ms). barness AssistantMessage has no timestamp and the spec does not decide one.
Same as result.timestamp, on the terminal event's message.
pi events carry the live partial message; barness events do not yet expose PartialView snapshots.
pi keeps the provider's raw terminal status (Responses: response.status) beside the mapped StopReason; barness does not carry it yet.
Same as result.rawStopReason, on the terminal event's message.
Cost estimation from the frozen catalog pricing is not implemented.
Same as result.usage.cost, on the terminal event's message.
pi reports reasoning tokens (output subset) in Usage; barness Usage lacks the field.
Same as result.usage.reasoning, on the terminal event's message.
pi's simple entry defaults maxTokens from the model (buildBaseOptions), so streamSimple sends max_output_tokens=32768 for gpt-4.1-mini; barness SimpleOptions mapping is not implemented.
Derived from the request body; differs only while request.body differs (currently max_output_tokens on the simple entry).
